definitions.explanation: A person who has graduated from university, or the educational background of holding a bachelor's degree. An abbreviation of {大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう}.

examples.japanese: {大卒|だいそつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初任給|しょにんきゅう}→初任給：11779_shoninkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the starting salary for university graduates?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大卒|だいそつ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧しか⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company only hires people with at least a university degree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大卒|だいそつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{三|さん}{年生|ねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, job hunting for university graduates starts in the third year of college.

notes:
Abbreviation of ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧ (university graduation). One of the most common abbreviations seen in job listings and discussions about education and employment in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大卒|だいそつ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧ — university degree or above (job requirement)
- {大卒|だいそつ}⟦{初任給|しょにんきゅう}→初任給：11779_shoninkyuu⟧ — starting salary for university graduates
- {大卒|だいそつ}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ — hiring of university graduates
- {大卒|だいそつ}⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧ — university-level (in civil service exams)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{高卒|こうそつ}→高卒：19284_kousotsu⟧ — high school graduate
- ⟦{院卒|いんそつ}→院卒：23152_insotsu⟧ — graduate school graduate
- ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧ — new graduate (fresh out of school)
- ⟦{既卒|きそつ}→既卒：15162_kisotsu⟧ — past graduate (already graduated but not yet employed)
